notes: Algolia / React-InstantSearch listing on Next.js, same-origin on edwards.com. The ?country=Costa%20Rica filter is URL-addressable via the 'Select country / region' combobox, which performs a real navigation. Prefix /job is an explicit override: derivation from any sample yields the id-specific /job/<id>. Board paginates at 10 per page, hence paginate=True, and 18 matches the page's own 'Showing 1-10 of 18 results' counter. This is the board that motivated hooks.render_wait_sec: its first job anchor appears at 46-50s (measured over three trials: 46s, 50s, 49s) and is reliably ZERO at 8s, 12s, 20s and 30s, so the global 8s settle had the matcher run against an unhydrated document and return a confident zero. render_wait_sec=60 gives roughly 10s of margin over the observed worst case; 4 of 4 live runs return 18. It also motivated settings.navigation_timeout_ms: Playwright's 30s goto default fired before the settle ever ran, because this board's load event does not arrive inside 30s either. If it ever regresses to an under-count the fix is a higher ceiling, or replacing the fixed sleep with a poll-until-anchors-appear whose ceiling this value becomes. Capture reads the same two hook fields with no flags passed, so the frozen fixture and the runtime observe the same DOM by construction.
